name: Turnaround: Chain Manta
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Generate a production 3D modelling reference sheet for Chain Manta. Image 1 is the authoritative canonical identity. Exactly SEVEN drawings in two rows. Top row five equal-scale neutral views LEFT TO RIGHT: left SIDE profile facing left, FRONT looking at camera, BACK facing away, TOP looking straight down, front THREE-QUARTER. Bottom row: core-exposed pose and attack anticipation pose. Use the full width; keep all seven subjects separate. 1970s anime production model sheet, confident dark ink contours, readable flat cel colour masses, very restrained gouache brush detail. Uniform warm cream background. Even neutral lighting, no cast shadows, no scenery, no captions, no words, no logos, no panel borders. Full subject in every panel, ample margins, never crop feet, tails or wing tips. Orthographic views must show the SAME character, not variants. CRITICAL ANATOMY: Flat manta body, two wing lobes, TWO chains ending in hooks trailing behind as in the canonical image. Show attachment roots and chain articulation clearly. Back core and separately vulnerable tether end. Model target bounds X,Y,Z metres: [14.2, 7.3, 7.6]. Rig/sockets to make visually possible: Core (back), TetherNode (weak point at the tether end), Hook.L/R, Hitbox.Body, Landing. Attack behaviour: Soar, Tether_Tell, Tether_Pull (wings brace), Release, Bank, Hit, Dissolve. The core-exposed and tell poses should reveal the mechanism without changing anatomy. New back/top surfaces should be the simplest continuation of existing armour. Blank unnumbered ruler ticks below neutral row. Request 3840x1920 pixels, 2:1 aspect. No text.
anatomy: Flat manta body, two wing lobes, TWO chains ending in hooks trailing behind as in the canonical image. Show attachment roots and chain articulation clearly. Back core and separately vulnerable tether end.

contract.name: Chain Manta
contract.summary: Hook-winged flyer that drops a tether onto a container or crane load and drags it sideways. Shooting the tether node frees the platform; stomping its back is a big bounce.
contract.joints: body, wing.L/R ×3, hook.L/R, tail ×3, tether (spline, 6 bones)
contract.clips: Soar, Tether_Tell, Tether_Pull (wings brace), Release, Bank, Hit, Dissolve
contract.sockets: Core (back), TetherNode (weak point at the tether end), Hook.L/R, Hitbox.Body, Landing
